classifiers: Silver-Russell syndrome, Sotos syndrome, Kabuki syndrome type 1, Down syndrome, Williams syndrome, CHARGE syndrome, ICF syndrome, 7q11.23 duplication syndrome
note: includes Down syndrome, whose comparators are unaffected siblings from its own series
Classifiers trained against out-of-series controls detect series membership, not disease. Coffin-Siris and Nicolaides-Baraitser are both in that category.
